title: HandAnthro: Automated Hand Anthropometry from a Single Image
abstract: arXiv:2609.37855v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hand anthropometry supports protective-glove design, but existing measurement methods often require trained operators, specialized hardware, or manual landmarking. We present HandAnthro, which estimates 44 projected hand dimensions from a smartphone photograph of a palm-up hand on US letter-size paper. The pipeline reconstructs wrist-occluded paper boundaries for rectification, whitens non-hand pixels, and refines 41 anthropometry-specific landmarks from a fine-tuned You Only Look Once (YOLO) pose model using image-specific geometry and contours. Controlled evaluation comprised 720 captures from 45 held-out participants, each contributing 16 images across two smartphones, two backgrounds, two angles, and two nominal illumination settings. translated_title: HandAnthro：基于单张图像的自动化手部人体测量
translated_abstract: 手部人体测量学为防护手套设计提供支持，但现有的测量方法通常需要训练有素的操作人员、专用硬件或手动标记关键点。我们提出了HandAnthro，它可以从一张手掌朝上放置于美国信纸尺寸纸张上的智能手机照片中，估算出44项手部投影尺寸。该流程重建被手腕遮挡的纸张边界以进行图像矫正，将非手部像素白化，并利用图像特定的几何与轮廓信息，从经过微调的YOLO（You Only Look Once）姿态模型中精化出41个专门用于人体测量的关键点。受控评估包括45名留出测试参与者的720次拍摄，每位参与者在两部手机、两种背景、两个角度和两种名义光照条件下各贡献16张图像。HandAnthro为704次拍摄（97.8%）生成了完整输出；在这些输出中，与两名受过训练的操作员的卡尺测量结果相比，每项尺寸的平均绝对误差（MAE）为3.80毫米。各区域的MAE为……
tldr: HandAnthro系统仅需一张智能手机拍摄的手掌照片即可自动估算44项手部人体测量尺寸，平均误差仅3.80毫米，可与专业卡尺测量媲美，为防护手套设计提供了便捷的自动化测量方案。
en_tdlr: HandAnthro automatically estimates 44 hand anthropometric dimensions from a single smartphone photo with 3.80 mm mean absolute error comparable to trained caliper measurements, enabling convenient protective-glove design.
